verdict.rationale: The evidence pack details QuickBooks' MCP server (145 tools, CRUD across 29 entities, sandbox/production split, write-safety toggles) but nowhere describes a mechanism for scheduling recurring jobs or workflows via API/MCP—no cron-like triggers, recurring-transaction API, or workflow scheduler for AI agents is documented. Mentions of 'automated payment reminders' or automatic bank imports are built-in consumer features, not an AI-native scheduling/automation primitive exposed to agents.
